mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate increases discount rates for equity valuation, reducing the present value of future cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is above its 50th percentile is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which contracts credit availability and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS above 4.5% is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, which amplifies recession risks and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) shows a positive Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are above their 50th percentiles.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) indicates weakening housing demand, which signals a slowdown in consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC for HOUST decline is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 5-day return when INDPRO is above its 50th percentile is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for UNRATE above 4.5% is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between RSAFS and 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 60-day return when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, which signals weakening corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO below 100 is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
